content.text:
The navigation bundle was not written. The session closed on the write command before the files were saved.

The generator parsed the current tree and built `entrypoints.json` (5090 characters) and `README.md` (1672 characters). Their combined length, 6762, is over the 6000-character limit, so the size check stopped the write. `source-navigation.zip` was not created. `/output` from that command is empty.

The AST scan of this snapshot did find `__main__` entries in `build_release.py` (72), `guarded_agent.py` (122), `guarded_session.py` (99), `guardian.py` (134), `guardian_mcp.py` (428), `peer_handoff.py` (101), and `runtime_supervisor.py` (375), plus `main` in the modules that define it. Observer and release symbols included `AgentObserver.observe` (line 36), `SessionObserver.observe` (line 101), `review_candidate` (line 10), `ScopeStop` (line 17), `judge_release` (line 31), and `runtime_supervisor.observe` (line 27). Those line numbers are from this tree only. Full SHA-256 values were computed inside the failed command and were not printed, so they are not listed here.
